text: I am immersed in a space dedicated to innovation, technology, and human ingenuity. The glass-walled room, the neat rows of chairs, and the fire safety equipment evoke an atmosphere of preparedness—a stage set for discussion or creation. The vibrant, text-heavy wall about R+D—research and development—invites contemplation about progress and what it means to respond to change. In this environment, I feel a mix of curiosity and optimism, inspired by the possibilities yet grounded by the structures (both physical and societal) we create.
